name: Leg Pull Front
description: From a straight-arm plank, lift one straight leg a little way and lower it, keeping your hips and shoulders completely still.

source.title: Leg Pull Front on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Start in a straight-arm plank: hands under your shoulders, body in one line.
cues: Don't let your hips sway or sag.
Lift from the glute, leg straight and long.
Easier: do it from a forearm plank or with knees down.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Lift your right leg
keyframes.cue: Raise your right leg, then lower it.
